g.text: SD01 — Create Character (UC01, F01; Factory Method)
(n1) static call on the class; cls = WARRIOR in this example
(n2) current location = start location, mode = new ExplorationMode()

(n3) CharacterCreation belongs to the Swing view: it keeps the backstory the form shows and ignores one that arrives after the player edited the form. :CliGameView can take the place of :SwingGameView (it has no form and no CharacterCreation)
(n4) the backstory is flavour text only: it changes no stat, HP or item
(fallback: the class's template backstory, with a notice)
